figdown 0.1 block

title "Alert-forwarding chain"

block probe "Probe"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block sink "Sink"

probe -> normalizer
normalizer -> sink

layout
pin probe->normalizer (60,20) (90,40)

The waypoints ensure the edge has the visual routing you specified, making room for other elements that might occupy the direct path between the probe and normalizer in the final layout.
